name: Snipo
description_en: Lightweight, self‑hosted snippet manager for saving and organizing code and text snippets with folders, tags, API, and GitHub Gist sync. ([Demo](https://snipo.melashri.dev/)) `AGPL-3.0` `Go/Docker`
description: Single user snippet manager web app.
readme_preview: Snipo is a lightweight, self-hosted snippet manager for a single user. > Snipo does not provide user accounts or tenant isolation. One master password > protects the instance.
